findings: The baseline does not meet the 500,000 m3 per ten-year period target. The archive does not record the modeler intent for that value; an unattainable minimum with a linear penalty, paired with even-flow, is a legitimate pull-up technique. The baseline sustains about 188,700 m3 per period.
The 1,277,067 m3 growing-stock floor at period 30 is not met; the baseline ends at about 495,500 m3.
The baseline is flat in absolute volume but not within the legacy -1 to 1 percent even-flow band when each period is compared with the final period. The target report records the deviations.
A one-time clearcut pulse of all age-80-plus blocks produces about 1.26 million m3 in the first decade and then no sustained harvest. It is retained as a structural smoke test, not a baseline.
schedule_definition: Clearcut at the minimum operable age (80 years), re-entered every 80 years, with first entries assigned to ten-year periods by a greedy volume-balancing heuristic. No spatial or patch targets are enforced.
